# Files that name a provider host: ghcr.io, github.com, api.github.com, googleapis.com, amazonaws.com, r2.cloudflarestorage.com.
# One path or glob per line with a reason. internal/seams fails an entry that matches no file with a host.
charts/motte/Chart.yaml # home and source URL of this project
charts/motte-vfsd/Chart.yaml # home and source URL of this project
.github/workflows/*.yml # workflows run on GitHub and publish to its registry and releases
internal/seams/providers.go # defines the host list and the SDK prefixes
internal/seams/seams_test.go # fixtures that hold hosts and SDK import paths
